title.headline: METALARM
title.line: A calmer MetalArm · four tabs · two taps a set

web.caption: A calmer MetalArm
web.voice: MetalArm has a new look. One accent colour, fewer words, and everything you already had, in four tabs. Here it is.

web.caption: Home: your rank, your week, one button
web.voice: Home starts with your rank and the experience to the next one. Then your week in three numbers, your last workout, and one button: start a workout.

web.caption: Friends' workouts and the leaderboard
web.voice: Below that, how you stand with friends, and their workouts. Tap the hand to spot one.

web.caption: The full leaderboard
web.voice: The whole leaderboard is one tap away, this week or all time. Your own row is the one that's tinted.

web.caption: Train: everything that starts a workout
web.voice: Train holds everything that starts a workout: what's up next, your routines, programs, ready-made workouts, and the exercise library.

web.caption: The exercise library
web.voice: The library lists every exercise. Search, or narrow it by muscle and equipment.

web.caption: A routine, then Start
web.voice: A routine shows its exercises, supersets and targets. Start is the one button that matters.

web.caption: One exercise in focus, one Log set
web.voice: In a workout, only the exercise you're on shows the steppers and Log set. Last time's numbers sit underneath. One tap logs the set and starts your rest.

web.caption: Supersets alternate on their own
web.voice: Finish a set in a superset and the focus moves to its partner. When an exercise is done, it moves on to the next one. That is two taps a set, at most.

web.caption: Everything else is in one sheet
web.voice: Set type, notes, rest, order and supersets are all in one sheet, out of the way until you need them.

web.caption: A record: a banner, not an interruption
web.voice: Beat a record and a banner rises from the bottom, with the points it earned, then gets out of your way. You're still mid-workout.

web.caption: The summary: what it earned
web.voice: Finish, and the summary shows the time, volume and sets, every point and where it came from, and the muscles you worked.

web.caption: Progress: one chart, your records
web.voice: Progress is one chart. All your training by week, or pick a single exercise to see its estimated one-rep max, with a dot on every record.

web.caption: History, week by week
web.voice: History shows the month at a glance, then every workout, grouped by week.

web.caption: Profile: you, then settings in groups
web.voice: Profile is you: your rank, your level and your lifetime numbers. Then settings, grouped: people, the game, training, the app, and your account.

web.caption: Quests, duels, parties and rewards
web.voice: Quests, duels, parties and rewards all live here now. Same features, calmer screens.

web.caption: Reduce motion: the app stands still
web.voice: And if you'd rather nothing moved, switch on Reduce motion. Every animation in the app stops.

web.caption: One system behind every screen
web.voice: Behind all of it is one small design system: one accent, six text styles, and the same building blocks on every screen.

web.caption: Lift. Level. Repeat.
web.voice: That's the new MetalArm. Lift, level, repeat.
